Task Name: Discovery: confirm multi-organization requirements
Description: Confirm expected owner/admin/manager behavior across multiple companies, separate views, combined views, permissions, billing/account assumptions, and audit expectations.
Acceptance Criteria: Approved product notes covering org switcher, combined timeline, roles, and permission rules.

Task Name: Discovery: confirm live Activities display requirements
Description: Confirm projector/big-screen use case, refresh expectations, update frequency, data freshness, visible indicators, and whether polling is acceptable for phase 1.
Acceptance Criteria: Approved product notes covering refresh method, target latency, and live display UX.

Task Name: Technical design: multi-organization access model
Description: Design database and auth changes for users who can belong to multiple organizations with per-org roles such as owner, admin, manager, and employee.
Acceptance Criteria: Design document includes schema, JWT/session behavior, migration strategy, and backward compatibility plan.

Task Name: Technical design: combined organization reporting
Description: Design how cross-org dashboards and activity timelines should query, aggregate, authorize, color-code, and filter data.
Acceptance Criteria: Design covers API shape, response fields, org metadata, filters, and performance considerations.

Task Name: Technical design: real-time Activities updates
Description: Choose phase 1 and phase 2 architecture for live timeline updates: polling first or WebSocket/SSE push later.
Dependencies: Discovery: confirm live Activities display requirements
Acceptance Criteria: Design includes update frequency, backend load impact, frontend state handling, and failure states.

Task Name: Database: add organization membership table
Description: Create migration for user_organization_memberships with user_id, organization_id, role, status, timestamps, and constraints.
Acceptance Criteria: Migration applies cleanly and supports one user across multiple organizations.

Task Name: Database: migrate existing users into memberships
Description: Backfill all existing users into user_organization_memberships based on users.organization_id and role.
Acceptance Criteria: Existing accounts continue working after migration.

Task Name: Backend: update auth login for multiple organizations
Description: Modify login/me responses so users with multiple memberships can receive available organizations and an active organization context.
Dependencies: Database: migrate existing users into memberships
Acceptance Criteria: Login returns organizations list and active org without breaking existing clients.

Task Name: Backend: add organization switch endpoint
Description: Add endpoint to switch active organization and issue/update token/session for the selected authorized organization.
Dependencies: Backend: update auth login for multiple organizations
Acceptance Criteria: User can switch only to organizations where they have active membership.

Task Name: Backend: add create organization for existing owner/admin
Description: Allow an existing authorized user to create another organization and become owner/admin of it.
Dependencies: Backend: update auth login for multiple organizations
Acceptance Criteria: Existing user can create Career Guide and Styling Minds style separate orgs under one account.

Task Name: Backend: update authorization middleware for memberships
Description: Ensure protected APIs validate the active org against membership instead of assuming users.organization_id only.
Acceptance Criteria: Unauthorized org access is rejected consistently across web APIs.

Task Name: Backend: update org-scoped service queries
Description: Audit and update services that use auth.OrganizationID so they remain correctly scoped under the active organization.
Dependencies: Backend: update authorization middleware for memberships
Acceptance Criteria: Teams, invites, attendance, screenshots, recordings, settings, usage, and live views remain org-isolated.

Task Name: Frontend: add organization switcher to dashboard shell
Description: Add a visible org switcher in the dashboard layout with current company name and available companies.
Acceptance Criteria: User can switch between companies without signing out.

Task Name: Frontend: update AuthContext for multiple organizations
Description: Store organizations list, active organization, and switch organization action in AuthContext.
Dependencies: Backend: update auth login for multiple organizations
Acceptance Criteria: Frontend session restore correctly loads multi-org state.

Task Name: Frontend: add create organization flow
Description: Add UI flow for an authorized user to create another organization from the dashboard.
Dependencies: Backend: add create organization for existing owner/admin
Acceptance Criteria: User can create a new company and switch into it.

Task Name: Backend: combined activity timeline API
Description: Add endpoint or query mode to return timeline data across selected authorized organizations.
Acceptance Criteria: API returns employees with organizationId, organizationName, and organization color metadata.

Task Name: Frontend: combined activity timeline filters
Description: Add Activities page filter for current organization vs selected organizations vs all organizations.
Acceptance Criteria: User can view separate or combined timelines.

Task Name: Frontend: company color coding on timeline
Description: Render combined activity timelines with clear company labels/colors and sorting/grouping options.
Acceptance Criteria: Employees from different companies are visually distinguishable on the Activities page.

Task Name: Backend: polling-friendly activity timeline performance
Description: Review indexes and query shape for frequent timeline refreshes over the current day.
Acceptance Criteria: Timeline endpoint can support periodic refresh without excessive database load.

Task Name: Frontend: auto-refresh Activities page
Description: Add automatic refresh to Activities page, likely every 15-30 seconds, without losing selected date/window/scroll state.
Acceptance Criteria: Projector screen updates without manual refresh and preserves user view state.

Task Name: Frontend: live mode indicator and controls
Description: Add live status indicator, last updated time, pause/resume refresh, and manual refresh action on Activities page.
Acceptance Criteria: User can see whether the board is live and when data last refreshed.

Task Name: Frontend: big-screen display mode
Description: Create projector-friendly mode for Activities page with dense timeline rows, larger labels, and reduced controls.
Acceptance Criteria: Activities page can be used on a large display without manual interaction.

Task Name: Backend: WebSocket/SSE live activity event design
Description: Design event contract for pushing activity/session/usage updates to dashboards in near real time.
Acceptance Criteria: Event schema and auth model are documented.

Task Name: Backend: implement live activity push channel
Description: Implement WebSocket or SSE channel for activity timeline events if phase 2 is approved.
Dependencies: Backend: WebSocket/SSE live activity event design
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized dashboard receives live activity update events.

Task Name: Frontend: consume live activity push events
Description: Update Activities page to merge pushed activity events into the existing timeline graph.
Dependencies: Backend: implement live activity push channel
Acceptance Criteria: Timeline grows live without waiting for full refetch.

Task Name: QA: multi-org auth and access testing
Description: Test login, org switch, org creation, permissions, and cross-org denial cases.
Dependencies: Frontend: add organization switcher to dashboard shell
Acceptance Criteria: Verified that users cannot access unauthorized organizations.

Task Name: QA: combined timeline testing
Description: Test separate org timeline, combined timeline, company sorting, color labels, empty states, and date filters.
Dependencies: Frontend: company color coding on timeline
Acceptance Criteria: Combined timeline works correctly for multiple companies.

Task Name: QA: live Activities projector testing
Description: Test Activities page open for 30-60 minutes with no interaction and confirm data keeps updating.
Dependencies: Frontend: live mode indicator and controls
Acceptance Criteria: Timeline updates repeatedly without manual refresh or UI degradation.

Task Name: Documentation: update AGENTS and local docs
Description: Document multi-org behavior, live Activities behavior, new APIs, and testing commands.
Dependencies: QA: multi-org auth and access testing
Acceptance Criteria: Future AI/developers can understand the architecture and test flow.

Task Name: Release: phased rollout and manager demo
Description: Prepare a staged rollout plan, demo script, known limitations, and rollback notes.
Acceptance Criteria: Manager can review separate org views, combined timeline, and live Activities behavior.
